main_text.head: TYPOGRAPHVS LECTORI.
main_text.p: CUM vir eruditissimus, & sanctæ in Ecclesiis nostris memoriæ David Blondellus, hoc opusculum suo hortatu & rogatu Latinè ex Gallico interpretatum ab auctore aliquot ante obitum mensibus ac-cepisset, praeloque destinasset, in ejus quam parabat, editionem paucis ad Lectorem praefatus erat. Eam nos praefationem in Schedis, ex quibus libellum excudimus, ipsius Blondelli manu descriptam nactí, hic in limine exhibendam censuimus, ne vel opus honorifico viri magni testimonio, vel lectorem haudquaquam inutili admonitione fraudaremus.

page.notes: The first word "CUM" is a large woodcut initial C, read as "CUm" with the initial joined to "um". The printed title is set in spaced capitals; "TYPOGRAPHVS" is written as printed with V for U. The page continues beyond this part, so the last line is cut off mid-sentence. The woodcut headpiece is not text and is shown only as a placeholder. The first line of the scan is partly cut at the left edge; words such as "accepisset" and "praeloque" are read from the visible letters. The printed word "Lectori" in the lower right is the catchword. The mark "* 2" is a signature-like mark, given as a foot line.
